research.title: Robustness of Intent Classification Under Paraphrase Variation
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to compare intent classifiers on meaning-preserving paraphrases, controlling training splits and grouping examples by linguistic variation.
Evaluated lexical and contextual baselines, examined prediction changes across paraphrase pairs, and categorized errors involving negation, reordered clauses, and ambiguous intent boundaries.

work.title: Support Ticket Routing and Text Processing
bullets: Implemented text normalization and routing rules for incoming support tickets, integrating validation checks for missing fields and inconsistent category labels.
Maintained regression tests for routing behavior, investigated misclassified tickets using application logs, and updated processing logic to address documented edge cases.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Document Retrieval Baselines
bullets: Implemented term frequency and probabilistic retrieval baselines for a document collection, using shared tokenization and relevance judgments for consistent comparison.
Compared ranking quality across query types and inspected retrieval failures involving rare terminology, vocabulary mismatch, and documents containing repeated query terms.

projects.title: Sequence Labeling for Named Entity Recognition
bullets: Implemented a bidirectional recurrent tagger and a conditional random field baseline, aligning preprocessing and dataset partitions for comparative entity recognition experiments.
Evaluated entity-level precision and recall, inspected boundary errors, and compared model behavior on unseen names and entities spanning multiple tokens.
